items.name: wick-theme
items.title: Wick Theme
items.description: A composable that builds a Wick Charts theme from your shadcn-vue CSS variables and follows dark mode.

items.name: wick-chart
items.title: Wick Chart
items.description: A canvas chart container, themed from your CSS variables and sized with classes. Put Wick Charts series and overlays inside.

items.name: chart-line-live
items.title: Live Line Chart
items.description: A line chart that streams a new point every second, with an animated live value in the card header.

items.name: chart-candlestick
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: Live OHLC candles in your chart colors, with an OHLC info bar, a crosshair and a price badge.

items.name: chart-order-book
items.title: Order Book
items.description: Cumulative bid and ask depth around the mid price in your chart colors, updated every second.

items.name: chart-sparkline-cards
items.title: Sparkline Cards
items.description: Three KPI cards with a live value, a change badge and an edge-to-edge sparkline.

items.name: chart-bar-grouped
items.title: Grouped Bar Chart
items.description: Two series side by side on a category axis, with a tooltip and a legend that toggles them.

items.name: chart-pie-donut
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: A donut with an animated total in the center; the slices resize as new data arrives.

items.name: chart-band-latency
items.title: Band Chart
items.description: Live latency percentiles: a median line over p25–p75 and p5–p95 bands.

items.name: chart-area-stacked
items.title: Stacked Area Chart
items.description: Two series stacked over three months, with a tooltip and a legend that toggles them.

items.name: chart-heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Sessions by weekday and hour on a ramp from your theme, with a cell tooltip.

items.name: chart-line-annotations
items.title: Annotated Line Chart
items.description: An error rate with an SLO line, a shaded incident window and a deploy marker.

items.name: chart-line-navigator
items.title: Line Chart with Navigator
items.description: A year of daily closes with a navigator strip to pick the visible window.
